displayName: OCI-DB-WEAV-001: Weaviate — Tenant Data Isolation Failure
description:
Detects cross-tenant data access in Weaviate vector database

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_db_weav_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%weaviate%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%tenant%') AND "value" > 0
dataSourceDetails.originalQuery: SELECT "siem_general_db_weav_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%weaviate%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%tenant%') AND "value" > 0
